server.name: Brasserie Georges
server.title: Brasserie Georges
server.description: Historic Lyonnais brasserie since 1836 offering fine food, craft beer brewed on-site, and multiple dining rooms.

tools.name: search_brasserie_georges_content
tools.title: Search Brasserie Georges
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about Brasserie Georges or the subjects it covers. Covers: menu du jour and daily specials, craft beer brewing on-site, dining rooms and facilities, reservations and bookings, history and heritage since 1836, Saturday evening jazz, gift options and merchandise, employment opportunities. Returns verbatim passages from the space's own content, kept current by its owners, each under the title of the entry it comes from. An empty result can mean the query was too narrow; a rephrased query may find the answer. Time-limited content (e.g. a daily special or a weekly schedule) is filtered out once expired, so when nothing current answers a question about today or this week, it has not been published yet. A passage carrying a "validUntil" date is a time-limited exception (e.g. an exceptional closure or opening) that overrides a permanent passage on the same topic until that date; the passage says when the period ends, or when it starts if it hasn't started yet.

tools.name: send_contact_request_brasserie_georges
tools.title: Send Reservation Request
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to request a table reservation or get in touch with the Brasserie Georges team by email. Sends an email request to the Brasserie Georges team containing the booking details collected from the user. The email is sent immediately and cannot be recalled; confirm the collected details with the user before sending.

from_name.description: Full name of the person making the request, shown as the sender

from_email.description: The user's email address. The team's reply goes to it, so ask the user for it rather than guessing

subject.description: Subject line the team reads first: what the request is about, in a few words

body.description: Message body for the booking request email. Before sending, collect from the user: the desired date and time, the number of guests, any allergies or dietary requirements, a phone number, and the guest name — ask for anything missing. Compose it following the pattern: 'Booking request - {name}, {guests} guests, {date} at {time}. Allergies: {allergies}. Reachable at {phone}.'

sent.description: True once the email has been handed to the mail provider

team.description: Name the team signs with, to tell the user who received the request

replyTo.description: The address the team's reply will go to, as supplied in from_email

tools.name: display_booking_slots_brasserie_georges
tools.title: Display Booking Slots
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to pick a date and time slot to book a table at Brasserie Georges. Renders a date and time-slot picker showing price, available dates, number of participants and a time grid with a Book button; the user's selection is returned to the conversation. Not for sending the final reservation email once details are gathered; use send_contact_request_brasserie_georges.

subtitle.description: Sub-heading, e.g. 'Price varies by group size'

date.description: Single available date (ISO). Use `dates` for several.

book_label.description: Confirm button label (overrides the space's configured label; default 'Book now')

book_prompt.description: Custom follow-up message template sent on confirm

colors.description: Color overrides. Override the theme and the space's configured brand colors.

accent.description: Accent color for buttons, selected states & links (hex)

tools.name: display_brasserie_images_brasserie_georges
tools.title: Display Brasserie Gallery
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see photos of Brasserie Georges, such as its dining rooms, the beer production or dishes. Renders one or more images in a gallery grid with a lightbox; a single image renders full-bleed, and if selection is enabled the user's chosen image is reported back.

selectable.description: If true, tapping an image selects it (a zoom button still opens the lightbox). The selection is reported back to you.

title.description: Name of the thing shown — a place, product, article — displayed as the item heading

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the title: what the item is and why it matters to the user

imageUrl.description: Image URL (https). Supplied by you — no lookup is performed.

badge.description: Short highlight displayed with the item, such as a price ("12 €"), a status ("Open now") or a category

label.description: Text of the button, phrased as what the user will get ("See the menu")

prompt.description: Follow-up message sent to the assistant when clicked

items.description: Images to display. `imageUrl` is required on each item.

colors.description: Color overrides. Override the theme and the space's configured brand colors.

accent.description: Accent color for buttons, selected states & links (hex)

tools.name: search_places_brasserie_georges
tools.title: Search Brasserie Georges Places
tools.description: Use this when the user asks where something is in Brasserie Georges, what is nearby, or which places Brasserie Georges covers. Covers: restaurant address and directions, location and contact details, nearby landmarks, parking access, how to get to Brasserie Georges. Returns matching places with their coordinates, from content kept current by the space's owners. Map and display tools render only the values they are given, so this is where their coordinates come from. An empty result can mean the query was too narrow; a rephrased query may find the place.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language: a place name, a type of venue or an area (e.g. "bouchon lyonnais in Vieux Lyon")

tools.name: display_brasserie_map_brasserie_georges
tools.title: Display Brasserie Map
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see the location of Brasserie Georges or nearby places on a map. Renders the given places as pins on an interactive map using each place's title and coordinates. Get the place titles and coordinates to plot from search_places_brasserie_georges first.

title.description: Heading shown above the map, e.g. "Bouchons near Bellecour". Omitted: no heading
Name of the place, shown on its marker card

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the title: what the item is and why it matters to the user

imageUrl.description: Image URL (https). Supplied by you — no lookup is performed.

badge.description: Short highlight displayed with the item, such as a price ("12 €"), a status ("Open now") or a category

label.description: Text of the button, phrased as what the user will get ("See the menu")

prompt.description: Follow-up message sent to the assistant when clicked

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), as returned by a search or geocoding tool

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), as returned by a search or geocoding tool

rating.description: Rating shown next to a star on the place card, on the scale of its source (e.g. 4.5 out of 5). Omit it when unknown: 0 or absent hides it

tags.description: Short keywords listed on the place card, such as cuisine, type of venue or amenities

items.description: Places to display, one numbered marker each, in the order given

totalResults.description: Number of places actually placed on the map

location.description: Address as supplied, empty when none was given

places.description: The places shown, in marker order (marker 1 first)
